sources.title: ProsMAE: Multi-Source MAE Pretraining for ISUP Grade Classification ...
sources.snippet: The model trains on 224×224 tiles resized from 1024×1024 tissue regions, with each whole-slide image contributing 100 tiles. Pretraining takes 5000 steps (capped at 20 epochs) using AdamW with learning rate 5×10⁻⁵, running on GPUs for only 10-11 hours—faster than standard autoencoders and comparable to vanilla MAE.
